summary: Convert dimensionless k c/omega_pi and propagation angle into SI perpendicular and parallel coordinates.

capability: Convert dimensionless k c/omega_pi and propagation angle into SI perpendicular and parallel coordinates.
operation: convert EM scan coordinates into SI wavevector coordinates
dimensionless kj, c/omega_pi and angle -> SI kx, kz, k and theta
discovery.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
discovery.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
discovery.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: k=kj/cwp, kx=k sin(theta), kz=k cos(theta); cwp=c/omega_pi uses explicit source reference species, theta in degrees.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

inputs.name: kj
inputs.description: Signed normalized radial wavevector parameter k*c/omega_pi; negative values are allowed.
inputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

inputs.name: theta_degrees
inputs.description: Propagation angle from the magnetic-field axis.
inputs.constraints: Finite and representable in the declared numeric type.

outputs.name: kx
outputs.constraints: Derived float64 arithmetic from the declared finite inputs; no additional post-division finite-output guard is applied.

outputs.name: kz
outputs.constraints: Derived float64 arithmetic from the declared finite inputs; no additional post-division finite-output guard is applied.

outputs.name: k
outputs.description: Signed radial parameter kj/cwp; not the nonnegative norm of the returned components.
outputs.constraints: Derived float64 arithmetic from the declared finite inputs; no additional post-division finite-output guard is applied.

outputs.name: theta
outputs.description: Input theta_degrees converted to radians without wrapping.
outputs.constraints: Derived float64 arithmetic from the declared finite inputs; no additional post-division finite-output guard is applied.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
supported: Finite scan values and positive finite reference length.
excluded: No implicit alternate reference species or radians.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for nonfinite/unrepresentable real scalars or cwp<=0.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Python/dependency errors propagate; this operator launches no native process and has no native execution receipt.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.

example.description: Bounded executable use of the actual declared scientific ports.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.dispersion.rational import em_coordinates
r = em_coordinates(0.1, 2.0, theta_degrees=71)
assert np.isclose(np.hypot(r['kx'], r['kz']), 0.05)

scope: Current SciRel implementation and the repository tests listed in this contract cover the declared public ports and numerical relation.
The example exercises one bounded representative case; it does not extend applicability beyond the declared preconditions.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to the dimensionless k c/omega_pi and propagation-angle to SI perpendicular/parallel coordinate transform. Evidence: `test_dispersion_rational.py` contains 6 test functions, 1 of which references `em_coordinates`, and is shared by 10 assets; only shared-file coverage is bound, so a pass is file-level rather than asset-isolated; the bounded example was executed by this audit. Oracle: self-consistency/regression against frozen coordinate values in the bound file. It does not establish an implicit alternate reference species or an implicit radian convention.
known_limitations: One direct function in the ten-asset-shared rational file covers extended finite input rejection after binary64 narrowing; the other five functions do not reference `em_coordinates`.
Finite-J/finite-N physics must be qualified for a new requested regime.
Earlier fixed-distance approach-to-axis ancillary assertions remain failed records; exact-axis/direct-response gates are separately qualified.
The relation is a finite scan-coordinate transform; no original-runtime execution or alternate reference species is bound.
No test binds a nonfinite or nonpositive-`cwp` case beyond the shared invalid-input contract.

references: Xie and Xiao, PDRK: A General Kinetic Dispersion Relation Solver for Magnetized Plasma, Plasma Science and Technology 18 (2016).
